message: The other day, I found myself feeling unusually proud as I zipped up our family's go-bags. After years of thinking about preparedness but never really getting around to it, I finally turned those thoughts into action. It felt good to have fresh water, important documents, and a little snack tucked away, just in case. For once, I felt like the organized one! Have you ever had a moment like that? What’s your favorite tip for being prepared?
